node.label: Moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
node.definition: A medium reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle, defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30-39 percent.

evidence.snippet: Cardiomyopathy, familial hypertrophic 27: Moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (frequency 3/3) [PCS]
